projects.title: Earthquake Analytics Pipeline
projects.description: Cloud-native data lakehouse analyzing 10+ years of global seismic activity. Implements Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), event-driven orchestration (Kestra), and partitioned/clustered warehouses optimized for query cost-efficiency.
projects.longDescription: An end-to-end data platform engineered to ingest, process, and analyze 500K+ seismic events from the USGS catalog. It features a fully reproducible cloud infrastructure provisioned via Terraform, resilient monthly batch orchestration using Kestra, and a medallion data model in BigQuery. Optimized query execution and storage costs by applying partitioning and clustering strategies on fact tables, exposing insights on Looker Studio.

stats.FinOps optimization: Minimized compute costs via partitioned fact tables

highlights: Developed a fully automated, version-controlled cloud infrastructure using Terraform for GCP setup.
Designed a resilient, monthly ingestion pipeline utilizing Kestra workflows with built-in retries.
Engineered a BigQuery-centered medallion data warehouse, partitioning tables by month and clustering by magnitude/region to optimize scan volumes and reduce querying costs.
Modeled robust SQL transformations with dbt, encapsulating raw data into clean marts and aggregate tables.
Created interactive, high-performance dashboards in Looker Studio with sub-second report response times.

projects.title: FreshCart E-commerce Analytics Pipeline
projects.description: Production-grade e-commerce analytics platform orchestrating a 7-task Airflow pipeline. Features a medallion data warehouse structure, customer RFM behavior segmentation, and automated testing preventing schema drift.
projects.longDescription: A robust batch ETL data platform orchestrating the flow of 150K+ transactional records. Powered by Apache Airflow (Docker LocalExecutor), the pipeline automatically ingests data to Google Cloud Storage and loads it to BigQuery. Using dbt, the data is transformed across Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers. Built-in SQL algorithms compute RFM segmentation to group customers into 10 behavioral profiles for marketing activation, while 20+ data quality assertions protect downstream BI stability.
highlights: Orchestrated a 7-task parallel Apache Airflow DAG on a Dockerized LocalExecutor, automating raw extraction, GCS loading, and multi-tier dbt compilation.
Designed a SQL-native RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) analytics model directly in dbt, grouping buyers into actionable marketing segments like Champions, Loyalists, and At-Risk.
Implemented 20+ automated data quality constraints (primary key uniqueness, category domain checks) to enforce data integrity.
Engineered a medallion architecture in BigQuery to isolate raw streams (Bronze) from analytics-ready business models (Gold).
Constructed high-density Looker Studio dashboards visualizing customer cohort retention, revenue trends, and catalog product rankings.

projects.title: AI-Native RAG Ingestion Pipeline
projects.description: Modular background ingestion pipeline parsing unstructured files, generating local dense vector embeddings, and serving semantic search queries via FastAPI.
projects.longDescription: A production-grade, secure, and self-contained Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) backend data platform. It parses raw unstructured documents, splits them into semantic text chunks using recursive splitters, generates dense vector representations locally using sentence-transformers, and stores them in Qdrant. Exposes FastAPI endpoints for semantic search and prompt-engineered RAG queries.

stats.security layers: SSRF scheme filter + request length restrictions

highlights: Implemented local open-source dense vector embeddings using SentenceTransformers, completely eliminating third-party API dependencies.
Created a resilient database client wrapper that automatically falls back to local disk-based storage if the server connection fails.
Built strict query length validation and secure protocol scheme Allow-lists to mitigate SSRF and buffer-overflow security risks.
Designed custom prompt engineering context builders to feed local Ollama LLMs with relevant source metadata.
Developed a containerized stack utilizing Docker Compose and automated testing suites via FastAPI TestClient.

projects.title: E-commerce Data Analysis
projects.description: End-to-end analysis of a public e-commerce dataset: SQL exploration and cleaning, RFM customer segmentation, and a Power BI dashboard of sales trends.
projects.longDescription: A complete data analysis workflow answering three business questions: who are the most valuable customers, which products drive revenue, and how do sales trend over time. The dataset is explored and cleaned in SQL (nulls, duplicates, date ranges), customers are segmented with RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) analysis, and the results are delivered as a Power BI dashboard for business stakeholders.
highlights: Explored the dataset in SQL: schema inventory, null checks, duplicate detection, and date-range profiling.
Cleaned and standardized data: status/category normalization, invalid-amount handling, and derived time dimensions.
Built an RFM segmentation model grouping customers into Champions, Loyal, At-Risk, and Lost segments.
Delivered findings as a Power BI dashboard covering sales trends, category performance, and segment value.

projects.title: Modern Data Warehouse with DuckDB
projects.description: Bronze → Silver → Gold data pipeline built with DuckDB and Python, demonstrating the Medallion Architecture end-to-end.
projects.longDescription: A hands-on implementation of a modern data warehouse stack. Raw CSV files are ingested into a Bronze layer as-is, cleansed and deduplicated into Silver, then modeled into star-schema marts in Gold — all with DuckDB and Python, no server required. Includes runnable sample data and a monthly revenue query against the final mart.
highlights: Implemented a three-layer medallion pipeline: raw Bronze ingestion, cleansed Silver layer, and analytics-ready Gold marts.
Used DuckDB for an embedded, zero-infrastructure data warehouse experience.
Modeled gold.fact_sales and gold.dim_customer following star-schema conventions.
Ships with sample data and a monthly revenue query, runnable with a single command.
